answer: Every identity locks a deposit in a shared vault and must answer a fresh proof-of-custody challenge each epoch: the network grows a random vine of retrieval tasks from its last attestation, and the agent must return signed fragments within seconds. One honest agent answers its own vine cheaply from its real disk. A sybil farmer hoarding a thousand identities on one machine cannot produce a thousand simultaneous proofs: missed answers echo into a canyon of slashing that drains the vault deposit of every silent puppet, so idle fakes starve while real custody is rewarded.
